newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF JOSEF STROBL.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF JOSEF STROBL.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of Josef Strobl, who won the men's World Cup giant slalom at Park City, Utah, on Monday:
Prior victories: One -- Val d'Isere, France, 1994, downhill

Other: "Pepi" Strobl wanted to ski giant slalom -- "my favourite event" -- for years but directors of the talent-rich Austrian team had other ideas. "I was sent to the Austrian downhill team first and we didn't ski GS. I asked last year to ski giant slalom, too, and trained during the summer."
